Use yq to extract the image field from this kubernetes deployment yaml on the command line:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: myrepo/api:v1.2.3
```

Use yq to edit replicas in place in this manifest without trashing the comments:
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web  # production deployment
spec:
  replicas: 2  # change to 5
```

Use yq to merge these two yaml configs while preserving comments and key order:
```yaml
# base.yaml
app:
  name: myservice
  port: 8080
# override.yaml
app:
  port: 9090
  debug: true
```

Use yq to convert this yaml file to json from the shell:
```yaml
name: app
version: 2.1.0
env:
  - name: DATABASE_URL
    value: postgres://localhost/mydb
```

Use yq to pull just the Deployment out of this multi-document manifest:
```yaml
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
spec:
  replicas: 3
```

Use yq to round-trip this TOML file to YAML and back:
```toml
[server]
host = "localhost"
port = 8080
```

Use yq eval-all to split this helm template output into one file per kind:
```yaml
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: app
```

Use yq -i to bump the image tag in this values.yaml to v1.2.3:
```yaml
replicaCount: 2
image:
  repository: myrepo/api
  tag: v1.1.0
```

Use yq to read the `services.db.environment.DATABASE_URL` field out of this docker-compose file in bash:
```yaml
version: '3.8'
services:
  db:
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://user:pass@db/mydb
```

Use yq to convert this JSON config back to YAML for a PR:
```json
{"server": {"host": "0.0.0.0", "port": 8443}, "logging": {"level": "info"}}
```

Use yq -i to delete the `metadata.annotations` block from this kubernetes resource on disk:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: app-config
  annotations:
    kubectl.kubernetes.io/last-applied-configuration: '{...}'
```

Use yq eval-all to override the `app.replicas` value in base.yaml with override.yaml at the CLI:
```yaml
# base.yaml
app:
  replicas: 1
# override.yaml
app:
  replicas: 5
```
